proposals.evidence: DEDR1693 gives Kannada guṇḍige heart, Tulu guṇḍigè, Telugu guṇḍe/guṇḍiya and Gondi guṇḍe heart. Selected simple guṇḍige/guṇḍikɛ/guṇḍiyɛ/guṇḍa-type responses are comparative heart-family matches. Whole -kāy compounds are analysed separately rather than truncated. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3748 gives Kannada nettar(u)/nettara/nettra, Tulu netterů and Gondi nettur/netur/nattur blood. Selected netter-/nettr-/naṭṭr-type survey responses preserve that stem with vowel variation or syncope; opaque Gondi naktur/naktar responses are excluded pending stronger consonant evidence. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
